text_en: I can't quite make out this path..._300_ This other one leads to...
Yes?_100_ How can I hel...? Aha,_100_ I knew you would return, yes._100_ You lot always return after putting me aside, although I could have sworn you went in the other direction.
Anyway, the important thing is that you have reconsidered and returned for my <color=OBJ>maps</color>._100_ This old dog can still be useful, yes.
As I've already told you, I'd love to hand them out for free, but if I want to keep helping stray travellers like you, I can't afford it.
I've signed it especially for you, see?_300_ Here it is:_100_ "Skribles".
This should keep you from getting lost,_100_ but you should know that my memory isn't what it once was,_100_ so you might come across routes of your own, yes?_300_ Onwards, tin man.
I thought you were going to take it this time. _300_ Don't worry, yes?_300_ I'll wait for someone who appreciates my work.
Aha..._300_ Back again?_100_ It doesn't bother me that you interrupt my work, no._300_ It's just that you should be more decisive in life, yes?_300_ I suppose you're here for the map.
It's not easy making these maps._100_ Every time I travel the plains, I find new paths. Keep that in mind, yes?
Here's a hill..._100_ and this is..._300_ a tree?
If I don't mark this river on the map, will people fall in?_300_ I would definitely fall in...
